e-pro-license-and-lockstep.1.evidence: free:2.0.5 pro:2.0.5 on buddynext-dev and on the clean Docker install.

e-pro-license-and-lockstep.2.evidence: Clean Docker install: Jetonomy deactivated with Pro active -> plugins.php shows 'Jetonomy Pro requires the Jetonomy plugin to be installed and activated.', no fatal, / and /wp-json/ 200; reactivating Jetonomy restores the community (200) with no manual Pro step.

e-pro-license-and-lockstep.3.evidence: Both active: /wp-json/jetonomy/v1/ 200 (both sites), /wp-json/jetonomy-pro/v1/ 200 on buddynext-dev. Free deactivated: /wp-json/ 200, jetonomy routes 404, never 500. On a fresh install the jetonomy-pro/v1 namespace is absent until Site Announcements or Attachments is enabled (by design).

e-pro-license-and-lockstep.4.evidence: php bin/audit-rest-routes.php ../jetonomy-pro/includes/ -> OK (no mutation routes missing REST_Auth).

e-pro-license-and-lockstep.5.evidence: Needs a valid Jetonomy Pro licence key; the bench key is answered 'invalid' by the store.

e-pro-license-and-lockstep.6.evidence: Needs an expired key and the invalid-key form submit; not run without a licence fixture.

e-pro-license-and-lockstep.7.evidence: 30-day grace path needs a lapsed real licence; not run.

e-pro-license-and-lockstep.8.evidence: Tier gating needs a real tier licence; buddynext-dev runs a licence bypass.

e-pro-license-and-lockstep.9.evidence: Partial: store get_version for item 1660319 answers new_version 2.0.4 (Pro routed to its own product); free's check returns 2.0.4 with package host wbcomdesigns.com and no update offered to the newer installed 2.0.5. Offering a newer Pro version needs a valid key (not available).

e-pro-license-and-lockstep.10.evidence: Drift between the two zips not simulated in this release; 2.0.5 ships both at the same version (build lockstep gate passed).

e-pro-license-and-lockstep.11.evidence: No multisite install on the bench.

e-pro-license-and-lockstep.12.evidence: Clean Docker install, wp plugin uninstall jetonomy-pro: remove-data off -> 43 jt_ tables and 9 Pro options kept; remove-data on -> Pro's 20 tables and 8 of 9 Pro options removed, Jetonomy's 23 tables and settings untouched, /community/ 200. The option jetonomy-pro_license_grace_started is kept (owner to confirm it is deliberate: it stops a reinstall restarting the grace period).

e-pro-license-and-lockstep.13.evidence: License screen at 1440 (status, key, plan, expiry, Deactivate) and 390 (no horizontal scroll, button 155x44 in view); screenshots jetonomy-2.0.5-e13-license-1440.png / -390.png.

e-pro-license-and-lockstep.14.evidence: No licence REST route exists in Pro; the licence form handler requires check_admin_referer('jetonomy_pro_license_nonce') and manage_options; the key does not appear in the jetonomy-pro/v1 REST index or on the License screen.
